description: This PHP script is part of the SuiteCRM / SugarCRM project, providing an administrative interface to repair UTF encoding issues within the system. It manages user permissions, interacts with normalization services, handles HTTP POST requests to trigger repairs or rebuilds, displays status templates, and schedules background jobs for UTF encoding repair procedures.

classes.name: NormalizeRecords
classes.description: A class responsible for normalization and repair of record data, particularly for UTF encoding consistency. Provides methods to get repair statuses, validate repair source, and execute repair operations.

classes.name: NormalizeRecordsSchedulerJob
classes.description: A class managing scheduling of background jobs for normalization and repair tasks within the system.

methods.name: getRepairStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current status of the UTF record repair process.

methods.name: getExecutionMode
methods.description: Returns the current execution mode (synchronous or asynchronous) for normalization operations.

methods.name: isValidRepairFrom
methods.description: Validates the provided 'repairFrom' datetime string for starting the repair process.

methods.name: setRepairStatus
methods.description: Sets the current repair status in the system.

methods.name: setExecutionMode
methods.description: Configures the execution mode for subsequent normalization operations.
